message:
fix(keepalive-r2 ②, c): the lease keeps its socket across a session -- the session gets a duplicate handle

Through a relay the standby lease is bound to the client endpoint (contract §2.7). Handing the lease's socket to the
session and opening a new one after made the Pings die at the relay and forced a re-admission. Now ActivationArgs()
gives ClientSessionController a DUPLICATE handle (WSADuplicateSocket / dup) -- the session owns and closes that one --
and the lease keeps its own, unread while the session runs; after it, the entry goes on by Ping on the same endpoint.
